title: A counterexample to Sidorenko's conjecture
main_claim: The incidence graph H of a specific 22-triple system on 13 points (35 vertices, 66 edges, bipartite) has a finite simple host G with t(H,G) < p(G)^66. The paper also derives tensor-power amplification, an injective-copy deficit, and failure of the CFS forcing conjecture.
coverage: Read every section of the LaTeX. Machine-checked the complex: 33 pairs, each in exactly 2 faces; degrees 4/5/6; every a_e >= 1/3 and a_{0,2} = 1; each of the 6 bit classes has 11 faces, covers all 13 points and is connected; colour refinement of H becomes discrete on all 35 vertices. Checked the reduction in sec. 3 step by step: coordinate expansion, regrouping of the parity product into the overlap moments phi_alpha phi_beta, base-law zero moments, support forcing to the single labelling alpha_e = U_e with value -(theta/2)^66, the pinning lemma (completed-square identity and lexicographic weights), thinning, dilution factors eps^13 vs eps^22, the crossed product giving t(W)t(W^T), and the finite-host sampling constants. Checked the transverse section: the complementary-image sign relation chi(det B) = c0 xi1 xi2, the centre parametrisation by maximal L-isotropic subspaces, the normalisation exponents (constants 16 and 4), the restriction-sign covariance, and the Gauss-sum total-variation bound for the joint signs. Re-derived with sympy: the orbit pair-cost cancellation, g_C, the exact slack identity (eq. slack), the total-slack decomposition, all four coercivity endpoint formulas plus the delta<0 substitution, the leading coefficient A = (c-u+v)/2, the integer equality slack and its cases c=0/1/>=2, the lower-activity baseline inequality, and the residual span counts (618, 1575, 1641, and the direct-case exponent -sum b(h_e)). Read the planted-gain counts and the triple-orbit lower bound and checked them for consistency (sanity cases L1=L2=L3 giving 2b(r) and a transverse triple giving 0), but did not re-derive the orbit classification independently. Consequences section checked.
sibling_notes: No sibling entries existed on the family-161 board when I started. The paper is self-contained, with no dependence on companion papers.
